records.name: uwait
records.tagline: Get paid while AI thinks
records.description: Every time you use ChatGPT or Claude, you wait. Usually 3 to 8 seconds. That's it. records.description: Meet Arcrawls, the context-aware browser pet that truly understands your vibe. Arcrawls crawls your screen, reacts to website sentiment, and levels up to unlock 140+ animations. He’s more than just a mascot. Use the new voice-enabled Chat to talk to him in custom personas (Sarcastic, Gen Z), complete with Markdown support and text-to-speech! Best of all? It’s 100% offline and privacy-first. Your data never leaves your machine. Arcrawls is your ultimate browsing companion!

records.name: Agentic Document Extraction
records.tagline: Make the world's documents computable
records.description: LandingAI is on a mission to make the world's documents computable. Agentic Document Extraction helps enterprise developers build document automation pipelines at scale. Composable agentic APIs provide accurate and auditable document parsing and field extraction with detailed citations. LandingAI has sophisticated cost optimization designed in via intelligent routing making it a very affordable option. Available as SaaS, as a VPC (AWS, Azure, GCP), as a Snowflake App, and on premise.

records.name: Peek
records.tagline: A quiet macOS menu bar switcher for keyboard-heavy work.
records.description: Peek helps Mac users switch between apps and windows without opening a heavy workspace tool. The core switcher is free, with Pro for unlimited favorites, hidden apps, layout control, and direct license activation.

records.name: 众腾微信号仓
records.tagline: 实名号和白号有什么区别
records.description: 微信号购买，本站主营各类微信号购买出售批发：有私人微信号,微信老号,实名微信号,微信小号,微信白号,企业微信号,私人绑卡实名微信号,站街号,vx,wx,wechat,白号,1年,2年,3年老号新号售后有保障，自动发货。

records.name: Yaad — Reminders that actually reach you
records.tagline: A tiny desktop reminder app built in rust for ADHD brains
records.description: Yaad (یاد — Urdu for "remember") is a desktop reminder app that fires native OS notifications with built-in jitter and pattern-interrupt framing — so they actually cut through the noise. Powered by Honker!

records.name: Selector Forge
records.tagline: Browser extension for AI-generated resilient selectors
records.description: Browser extension to create reliable CSS and XPath selectors using AI. You can use it to create a selector for a single element or for an array of elements. The selectors it creates are meant to be "semantic" and more resilient to page changes! Extension is also open source on GitHub: https://github.com/Intuned/selector-forge

records.name: Keygent
records.tagline: Run terminal commands with safely injected env vars
records.description: Keygent is a lightweight, zero-dependency CLI tool written in Go that executes terminal commands with temporarily injected environment variables. It uses a direct execution model to run commands safely without polluting your global system environment. Upcoming updates will introduce seamlessenv file parsing, centralized project configurations, and password-encrypted global environment profiles.

records.name: Quorum Check
records.tagline: The Pulse of the Public, In Real Time
records.description: The Pulse of the Public, In Real Time. Privacy-first polling for leaders. A dual-sided ecosystem coming soon: creators build targeted, transparent polls — users vote, discuss, and track live trends without sacrificing their privacy.

records.name: DIYCalcKit
records.tagline: Free home improvement calculators — no signup needed
records.description: Free calculators for every home project. Paint, flooring, tile, renovation costs, fencing, moving, and more — all in one place.

records.name: Poople Answer
records.tagline: Poople Answer - Daily Solutions & Hints
records.description: Find Poople answer today with spoiler-safe hints, shortest path strategy, daily archive links, and a clean playable guide for word ladder fans.

records.name: Darsh Fitness
records.tagline: Log Meals, Track Calories, Get Results
records.description: Log a meal in seconds — just type the dish. Deep Indian-food coverage, full macro tracking, trends, and total privacy. Free, no ads, your data stays yours.

records.name: Tokuplay APK
records.tagline: Streaming Tokusatsu untuk Android
records.description: TokuPlay APK adalah aplikasi streaming Android untuk penggemar Tokusatsu di Indonesia. Nikmati Kamen Rider, Super Sentai, Ultraman, dan lainnya dalam satu tempat.

records.name: Pexpats Business Search
records.tagline: One Search. Every Czech Business Record.
records.description: Search Czech companies, freelancers and trade licenses by IČO, DIČ, company name or personal name. Verify business details, VAT registration, company owners, directors, registered capital and public registry records from multiple Czech sources in one place.

records.name: Prompt Smartly AI
records.tagline: Grammarly for AI Prompts
records.description: Prompt Smartly AI optimizes your AI prompts instantly. Works inside ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini. Get dramatically better AI results with one click — free browser extension and integration into ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini AI Tools to optimize the prompt in one click.

records.name: TravelVisaRules
records.tagline: Check visa rules for your passport
records.description: TravelVisaRules helps travelers check visa requirements by passport and destination. Pick your passport, choose where you are going, and get a clear travel entry answer: visa-free, eVisa, visa on arrival, ETA, or visa required — with stay limits, estimated costs, document checklists, official links, and last-verified dates.

records.name: Flash 'n' Dash
records.tagline: Interactive arcade flashcards with global leaderboards.
records.description: Flash 'n' Dash is a dynamic learning game that turns flashcards into an arcade experience. Master topics in discovery mode, then test your reflexes in a timed arcade mode. What sets us apart? You can compete on global leaderboards for every deck to earn Gold, Silver, and Bronze medals! With daily streaks and a playful, vibrant design, learning finally feels like a game instead of homework.

records.name: Design Li Ai
records.tagline: Showcasing bold graphic design and creative storytelling
records.description: Ali Guerriche — Professional Graphic Designer. Transforming ideas into bold, memorable visual identities.
